capabilities: Record debts and receivables per person
Track partial payments and remaining balances
Calculate the net balance between two people
Store records as editable Markdown notes
disambiguation: Not a password or login-credential manager; it tracks money owed between people.
extras: All records live in one central data note rather than per-person notes. Interface and digits support both Persian and English, and amounts can be shown in Toman. Core features need no external server.
motivation: The author wanted personal financial records kept as editable Markdown records inside Obsidian instead of in separate applications or spreadsheets, following the principle that data belongs in the vault.
problem: Money owed between people is usually tracked in separate finance apps or spreadsheets, away from the vault where the rest of one's notes live.
summary: Debt and receivables manager that records people, transactions and partial payments in Markdown notes and computes remaining and net balances.
